name: Alejandro Puente
bio: Alejandro Puente is a Mexican actor, writer and director of short films. Known in his native country for his role as Todd Anderson in the Mexican stage adaptation of Dead Poets Society, starring Alfonso Herrera. Although he previously made his television debut in the series El Dandy. In New York, United States, he was a disciple of Darren Aronofsky, a great director and screenwriter. Puente in his short career as a director and writer has produced two films; Goodbye, Hamburg (2018), and Verónica (2018).
